user.description: Enter your TheSportsDB API key and the team name to track. Use 123 as the API key if you do not have one. You can also enter a national team name such as 'Sweden' or 'Tre Kronor'.

data.team_name: Team name (e.g. Rögle BK, Djurgården, Sweden, Arsenal)

pick_sport.description: Multiple sports matched that team name. Please select the sport.

pick_team.description: Multiple teams were found. Please select the correct one.

confirm_team.description: Track {team} ({sport})? TheSportsDB lists its primary league as {league}. Recent and upcoming matches include: {leagues}.

browse_sport.description: Choose a sport and enter the country whose teams you want to browse.

browse_team.description: Choose a team, or choose a league to filter the list of teams.

league.description: Choose which competitions to include for this team. National teams only have international competitions, so 'National leagues and cups only' is not available for them.

data.specific_league: Specific league (only when 'Specific league' is selected above)

error.team_not_found: No team found with that name. Try a different spelling.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.
